description_en: Effectively detects vehicle license plate information. Support includes motor vehicle license plates, motorcycle license plates, and temporary license plates.
description_zh: 可有效识别车辆车牌信息，支持机动车车牌、摩托车车牌以及临时车牌
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-car-number --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1Wo7eXAvoK1RjSZFDXXXY3pXa-2512-3509.jpg --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeCarNumber

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive—you cannot pass through both or leave both empty.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you cannot pass through both or leave both empty.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary file of the image in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
